captions.detailed: A full-floating rear axle assembly with a central spherical differential housing, two cylindrical axle tubes extending outwards, and dual hub-and-drum assemblies at the ends. The housing and axle tubes are colored a dark matte black, while the rotating wheel hubs feature metallic silver details and small red markers on the drums. The internal axle shaft and the outer drum hubs are designed to rotate continuously relative to the fixed axle housing.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated full-floating rear axle shaft assembly. It should feature a central spherical differential housing, two symmetrical axle tubes extending laterally, and rotating hub-and-drum assemblies on each end with continuous rotational joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by first defining a central housing using a Sphere primitive combined with a cylindrical pinion extension. Symmetrical left and right axle tubes are created as Cylinder primitives. The rotating wheel hubs are modeled with multi-step cylindrical extrusions representing the brake drums and the outer hubs, detailed with small polar-patterned bolt cylinders. Continuous joints are then defined to allow the left and right hub assemblies to rotate independently relative to the main axle housing.
